verdict.rationale: Community comments point to an official Postmark MCP server (a landing page at postmarkapp.com/lp/mcp and the ActiveCampaign/postmark-mcp repo), separate from the malicious third-party npm 'postmark-mcp' package, which says nothing against the official server. However, no first-party docs in the pack describe the server's setup, tools or auth. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the MCP server, its tool coverage and connection/auth flow, and hands-on corroboration of an agent connecting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: postmark has its own official mcp server as well: https://postmarkapp.com/lp/mcp
the official repo has 1 watch 0 fork and 2 stars: https://github.com/ActiveCampaign/postmark-mcp
